basis: Labels are inferred from post text, not from watching the videos.

families.name: Product reveal
families.summary: The post leads with the name and the category: here is the new thing.
families.watch_for: Works when the first frame already shows the product doing its job. Weak when it is only a logo and a label.

families.name: Input to output
families.summary: A plain input becomes a finished result on screen.
families.watch_for: The strongest proof family. Check that the input looks real and the output is not edited.

families.name: Specific grievance
families.summary: Opens on a named, familiar pain the viewer already feels.
families.watch_for: Needs a fair baseline. The pain has to be shown or sourced, not just claimed.

families.name: Removed constraint
families.summary: Doing a known task without the usual requirement.
families.watch_for: The missing requirement must truly be gone. State the exceptions.

families.name: Measurable stakes
families.summary: Leads with a number: money, time, scale, or a result.
families.watch_for: Ask whose number it is and how it was measured. Funding is not a result.

families.name: Authority and mission
families.summary: A founder fact or a mission line earns trust before the demo.
families.watch_for: Only useful when trust is the gap. The demo still has to follow fast.

families.name: Comparison
families.summary: The same job done two ways, side by side.
families.watch_for: Inputs, versions, and scope must match or the comparison misleads.

families.name: Objection ownership
families.summary: Names the common complaint about the category, then answers it.
families.watch_for: The output on screen has to actually answer the complaint.

families.name: Not labeled
families.summary: The post text did not make the hook clear, or the record has not been labeled.
families.watch_for: Watch the first five seconds and label it with add-launch-record.
